The same compliance report's monitoring annexes give three sampling points labelled 'At Project site': soil SQ-1 19 11 07.96 N, 73 00 13.39 E; air AQ-1 19 11 10.00 N, 73 00 13.86 E; noise AQ-1 19 11 06.72 N, 73 00 14.05 E. All three lie inside this ring (about 100 to 122 m from the nearest vertex).

Digital Edge's India page describes '350MW on 47 acres'; 47 acres is about 190,200 m2, within 0.2% of the ring's geodesic area (189,834 m2). The EC data sheet's 'Total Plot area: 172354 sq.m' is about 9% smaller than the ring.
Digital Edge's 31 August 2026 release places BOM1 (operational), BOM2 (topped out) and BOM3 (under construction) on its Navi Mumbai campus.

precision: Centroid of the proponent-submitted 'Project Site - Data Center' ring (about 19.0 ha, roughly 0.96 by 0.86 km) hosted by PARIVESH for the Digital Edge BOM proposal. It locates the campus property, not the BOM2 building, a surveyed boundary or the current works extent.
